Hi Julia — thanks for calling that out. Short answers: yes, Redwood will have an officer countersign. We typically have our Head of Legal or VP of Finance countersign DPAs depending on the account and region; for EU contracts we prefer the Head of Legal. Delegation: we keep a documented delegation for the countersigning role in our legal folder; happy to share a certified copy to satisfy procurement.

On eSignature vendor: we prefer DocuSign for consistency and audit trails, but we will accept AdobeSign for EU-only agreements if Acme requires it for eIDAS compliance. Operationally, switching vendors adds a one-business-day manual step to package the envelope and update webhook callbacks.

Next steps I propose:

- If Acme requests AdobeSign, operations will perform the vendor handoff; we will notify you of the envelope link.
- Priyom will confirm the authorized Redwood signer and attach the delegation cert to the envelope.
